metadata.Name: STAIR Captions
metadata.Description: This paper introduces STAIR Captions, a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset. The dataset consists of 180k image-caption pairs, and is constructed by collecting images from the web and annotating them with captions written by native Japanese speakers. The dataset is intended for use in image captioning and other multimodal tasks.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Abstract: We present STAIR Captions, a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset. The dataset contains 180K image-caption pairs collected from the web and annotated by native Japanese speakers. We describe the dataset construction process and present preliminary experimental results on image captioning. The dataset is publicly available for research purposes.
